name: RF Induction Technology
description: ONEX RF heating provides precise, consistent energy delivery for repeatable catheter manufacturing processes.

name: RF Welding
description: RF (radio frequency) welding is a process that uses high-frequency electromagnetic energy to join two layers of thermoplastic materials by creating an airtight and durable bond.

name: Catheter Tip Forming Theory
description: Catheter tip forming theory is the science behind the process of forming the distal ends of thermoplastic catheters to achieve smooth, atraumatic tips for device insertion. It is a complex process that requires a deep understanding of the materials, the equipment, and the process parameters.

name: Hybrid RF Generator Technology
description: Hybrid RF generator technology for RF welding and RF heat sealing machines: fast arc shut-down, closed-loop power control, and automatic impedance matching for repeatable seals.
